posts.text:
My grandfather gave me one last gift before he passed away: a Bible.

Inside, he wrote four words: "Have faith, not fear."

Fear is the accelerant of nationalism. Faith is the foundation of patriotism.

Let’s choose faith.

The Maryland Energy Administration has filed a complaint to END an unfair utility surcharge that’s costing Maryland families tens of millions of dollars.

We won't let big corporations pad their profits on the backs of hardworking Marylanders.

No one should have to justify who they love or how they express themselves.

I’m grateful to have worked alongside LGBTQ+ advocates to make Maryland a safe haven for their community. Together, we’ve passed the Trans Health Care Equity Act, decriminalized HIV, and doubled funding for hate crime prevention – and we’re not done!
